part.name: Pedestal support and clamp bracket
part.description: Single-piece mechanical bracket with an elongated mounting base, a curved upright support containing an open cradle-like clearance region and paired side slots, an upper block, and a raised axial boss with a central bore. The model is one connected CAD solid rather than an assembly.
part.symmetry_note: The mounting base has a paired-hole arrangement and rounded end corners. The two elongated side slots are approximately mirror-paired across the mid-thickness plane. The raised boss and its bore are rotationally symmetric about an axis parallel to CAD Y. The overall upright profile is not globally symmetric because of the open cradle geometry.

semantic_orientation.description: The long plate is interpreted as the bottom mounting base, with the upright and raised boss above it. CAD +Y corresponds most plausibly to the human-semantic top. The broad faces at CAD Z=0 and Z=-42 are interpreted as front and back side faces respectively; front/back and left/right assignments remain conventional rather than functionally proven.
